verdict.rationale: HubSpot is a SaaS CRM with AI features (Breeze agents, AI reporting), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting, policy, or contractual commitment that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. The AI pages describe agents 'built on your CRM data' but say nothing about training controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
